source.postQualificationChanges: This qualification file and its server-image contract link only.

implementation.completeNativeReferences: Room::retained_asset_references reads conservative accepted causal and effect-author history plus every complete typed version, proposal and revision Prepare in the retained original log. Orphaned and superseded preparations remain dependency sources without becoming publications.
implementation.currentCapture: ServerBackupHandle::capture_asset_recovery_state authenticates the current owner and binds complete actual log, raster, registration and native reference reads to one current cut under room-then-assets locks.
implementation.currentBytes: verify_server_asset_availability requires an independently selected current cut, actual native raster bytes and an explicit currently checked provider guard. Exact original opaque asset/generation mappings are checked again; one immutable asset retains one content digest across generations.
implementation.genuineRecoveryJoin: verify_recovery_asset_availability accepts a genuine VerifiedServerRecoveryContinuation and joins it with actual native byte availability on the same host and exact current cut. No metadata or Boolean constructor substitutes for either live check.
implementation.liveProofs: Both new proof types retain native host and provider guards weakly, contain no raw credential or writer lease, and have no deserializer or default constructor. check_live reauthenticates and rechecks actual native files, sources, mappings and current provider authority.
implementation.wholePending: Missing native packet source, host mapping or actual payload produces no partial proof. Invalid mappings, corrupt files, stale selections and failed provider guards refuse.

regression.detail: A real native room containing the valid opaque asset ID sha256:opaque was rejected as a malformed content hash instead of returning missing mappings. A prefix alone was incorrectly treated as a content-addressed identity.
regression.fix: Use the exact canonical lowercase SHA-256 key predicate for the direct path, matching the existing SDK byte-capture policy. Other valid native IDs use the explicit host mapping resolver; mapping targets still require canonical content IDs.
regression.provisionalRunDisposition: The earlier provisional run was intentionally invalidated by its source-change guard while the regression test was added. It is not the accepted qualification. All 23 selected checks were rerun on the fixed frozen source.

remaining: The new proofs cover one native server/current cut and provider guard at one instant. They create or verify no operational marker and reserve no later mutation or activation barrier.

Every current participant and retained historic/offline client copy, extension source, complete global provider/reference reconciliation, protected credential custody and cross-device deployment/writer fencing remain activation requirements.
The approved cross-generation Undo/Redo and outstanding offline-edit bridge remains required; history reset, discarded offline work or higher persisted limits are not substitutes.
Node storage/lock/raster fixtures and production module imports do not qualify browser behavior, process/power-loss durability, quota/eviction or the large-room operating envelope.
All 13 V1 release gates remain open. Historical WebKit is not confirmed fixed; physical Japanese input and VoiceOver qualification remain deferred.
The existing capped vendored dependency warning, generic-btree notice gap and complete dependency/license approval remain unresolved. No push, tag, publication or deployment occurred.
